title: Support for Single-parent Families Including for Single Fathers
what_it_is: Support for Single-parent Families Including for Single Fathers

sections.label: Support for single-parent children
sections.summary: Children of single parents are eligible for MediSave, MediShield Life, CDA benefits, care subsidies, leave and levy concession, with extra subsidies for lower-income families.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Children of single parents are eligible for MediSave Grant for Newborns and MediShield Life coverage, Child Development Account (CDA) benefits, child and infant care subsidies, child and infant care leave, the Foreign Domestic Worker Levy Concession and other education and healthcare subsidies.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: On top of basic child and infant care subsidies, low- and middle-income families with working mothers or single fathers can enjoy additional subsidies for centre-based care for their children.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Depending on their household income, families receiving the highest tier of subsidies can pay as little as $3 per month for full-day childcare services.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For half-day kindergarten run by the Ministry of Education and Anchor Operators, lower-income families can pay as little as $1 a month after subsidies.

sections.label: Help for single parents
sections.summary: Single fathers and mothers needing financial help can approach Social Service Offices, and four Divorce Support Specialist Agencies and the KidSTART pilot support families.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Both single fathers and single mothers who require financial assistance to meet their basic needs can approach the Social Service Offices for help.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: My Ministry has also appointed four Divorce Support Specialist Agencies (DSSAs) to support divorcing and divorced parents and enhance child-centricity.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: To further strengthen the system of support, my Ministry also started to implement the KidSTART pilot programme in July last year.

sections.label: OCBC Starter Scheme
sections.summary: Under the OCBC Starter Scheme, OCBC directly contributes funds into a child's CDA when parents save.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Social and Family Development (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: One example is the Oversea-Chinese Banking Corporation (OCBC) Starter Scheme, where OCBC directly contributes funds into the child's CDA when parents save.
